notes_for_editor: Thin record: only two one-line listings exist, the FFLA Vermont list (type, status, coordinates) and an Eastern US Lookouts stub that reads Vermont - Essex County and Removed. No build date, height, staffing, fire history or site description was found in the sources or in two searches. The brief's second coordinate pair (44.60311, -71.6294, roughly 2.5 km east) does not appear in the Eastern page text, so it is unverified; the FFLA pair is used. The brief's kind 'platform' is corrected to crowsnest per FFLA. The county list (source 4) is used only for context about neighbouring Essex County entries. Do not mix with the Round Mountain pages for Maine (round-mountain1.html on the same Eastern site).
